scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
忍者的特長是快速移動。
他們擅長使用投擲武器。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Ninjas are kind of a hybrid class that can use various dodge skills with the capability of both physical and magical attacks depending on their preference.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
忍者是一種混合職業，可以根據喜好使用各種閃避技能，併兼具物理和魔法攻擊能力。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The biggest attraction of the stronger Novice, called Super Novice, is their pull to mediocrity.
They are the proverbial Jack-of-all-Trades but Master of none.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
更強的初心者，即超級初心者，最大的吸引力在於其平庸的傾向。
他們是典型的“樣樣通，樣樣松”。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Super Novices can learn most of the 1st job class skills.
If you become a Super Novice, you cannot change your job, which is too bad, but you can grow as a very individual character.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
超級初心者可以學習大部分一轉職業的技能。
如果你成為超級初心者，將無法轉職，這很遺憾，但你可以成長為一個非常獨特的角色。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
You can job change directly from Novice to a special class which is optimized for a long-distance attack with guns.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
你可以直接從初心者轉職為一種優化了遠端槍械攻擊的特殊職業。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Gunslingers use all kinds of guns made in 'Einbroch', the city of steel.
I recommend this for those who want to become powerful sharpshooters.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
神槍手使用在鋼鐵之城“艾音布羅克”製造的各種槍械。
我推薦想要成為強力神射手的人選擇這個職業。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
If you need more information,
you can always go to ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
如果你需要更多資訊，
你可以隨時訪問 ^2F4F4F'www.ragnarok.co.kr'^000000

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
These monsters are all weak and easy to kill. But be careful, a lot of them are aggressive and out for blood!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
這些魔物都很弱，很容易殺死。但小心，其中很多具有攻擊性，且嗜血成性！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
If you think monsters here are too weak for you, I can send you to another training ground where the monsters are stronger than the ones over here.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
如果你覺得這裡的魔物太弱了，我可以把你送到另一個訓練場，那裡的魔物比這裡的更強。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
So would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
那麼，你想試試嗎？

scripts.text: Send me to another Level
scripts.translation: 把我送到另一個等級

scripts.text: What monsters are there?
scripts.translation: 那裡有什麼魔物？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
I see, then let me guide you to another level. Which level do you want to go to?
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
明白了，讓我帶你去另一個等級。你想去哪個等級？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
You seem eager to fight.
The monster levels increase with each level of the training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
你看起來很有戰鬥慾望。
訓練場的每個等級，魔物的強度都會隨之增加。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 1 has the weakest monsters.
There you'll find Porings, Drops, and Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第1級的魔物最弱。
那裡有波利、土波利和瘋兔。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 2 is more challenging.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第2級更具挑戰性。
那裡有波利、瘋兔、樹精和蒼蠅。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 3 is the same as Level 2.
There you'll find Porings, Lunatics, Willows, and Chonchons.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第3級和第2級一樣。
那裡有波利、瘋兔、樹精和蒼蠅。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 4 has stronger monsters.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第4級的魔物更強。
那裡有樹精、蜂兵、小雞和綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Level 5 is the same as Level 4.
There you'll find Willows, Hornets, Pickys, and Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
第5級和第4級一樣。
那裡有樹精、蜂兵、小雞和綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Brutus]
Hmm...?
Are you worried about going to more challenging places? That's understandable, since you're still a new adventurer. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 布魯圖斯]
嗯...？
你擔心去更具挑戰性的地方嗎？這很正常，畢竟你還是個新冒險者。祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Welcome to the Training Grounds.
You are now in the outer court yard. Please go inside the castle to begin your training.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
歡迎來到訓練場。
您現在位於外庭院，請進入城堡開始您的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Come in! I would like to welcome you to the Training Grounds!
In here, you can prepare yourself for your future adventures throughout the Ragnarok world!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
請進！歡迎來到訓練場！
在這裡，你可以為未來在仙境傳說世界的冒險做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Go, Novice, go!
Fight, and grow stronger! Look towards a brighter tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
去吧，初心者，去吧！
戰鬥，變得更強！向著更美好的明天前進！

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Eh? Why are you still here?
There are no more courses that you need to take.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
咦？你怎麼還在這裡？
已經沒有你需要修的課程了。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Well, I will let you out of here.
Go find the instructor, Brade.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
好吧，我放你出去。
去找教官佈雷德吧。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Eh? Weird?
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
咦？奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Training Grounds have come under new management...
You seem to have come from the previous management.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
訓練場已經換了新的管理者...
你似乎是從舊的管理者那裡來的。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You may continue, you should have enough experience if you made it here.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你可以繼續，既然你能走到這裡，應該有足夠的經驗了。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
I will send you to any town that you'd like to go to.
Or do you have a favourite profession?
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
我可以把你送到任何你想去的城鎮。
或者你有喜歡的職業嗎？

scripts.text: Choose Profession.
scripts.translation: 選擇職業

scripts.text: Go to Towns.
scripts.translation: 前往城鎮

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
What profession would you like to perform?
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你想從事什麼職業？

scripts.text: Swordman
scripts.translation: 劍士

scripts.text: Acolyte
scripts.translation: 服事

scripts.text: Thief
scripts.translation: 盜賊

scripts.text: Merchant
scripts.translation: 商人

scripts.text: Archer
scripts.translation: 弓箭手

scripts.text: Mage
scripts.translation: 魔法師

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
That's a great choice!
After you receive all the supplies, I will teleport you to the Swordman Association.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
真是不錯的選擇！
領取完所有補給品後，我會將你傳送到劍士協會。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The town you will be sent to is called Izlude which is a satellite of Prontera. The Swordman Association is located in the West of town. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
您將被傳送到的城鎮名為依斯魯得島，它是普隆德拉的衛星城。劍士協會位於城鎮的西側。請牢記這一點。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become an Acolyte.
You will be sent to
the town of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你選擇了成為服事。
你將被傳送到普隆德拉的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Prontera Sanctuary is located to the North-East in Prontera. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
普隆德拉聖堂位於普隆德拉的東北方。請記好這一點。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become a Thief.
You will be sent to
the town of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你選擇了成為盜賊。
你將被傳送到莫洛克的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Thief guild is in the underground 1st floor of a pyramid which is North-West of town. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
盜賊公會位於城鎮西北方金字塔的地下1層。請記好這一點。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become a Merchant.
You will be sent to
the town of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你選擇了成為商人。
你將被傳送到艾爾貝塔的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become an Archer.
You will be sent to
the town of Payon.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你選擇了成為弓箭手。
你將被傳送到斐揚的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Archer Guild is located to the North-West in Payon. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
弓箭手公會位於斐揚的西北方。請記好這一點。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have chosen
to become a Mage.
You will be sent to
the town of Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你選擇了成為魔法師。
你將被傳送到吉芬的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
The Mage Academy is located in the North-West in town. Please remember this.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
魔法師學院位於城鎮的西北方。請記好這一點。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
To what town do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你想去哪個城鎮？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐揚

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Never mind
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
You have received all the supplies.
To what town do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你已經收到了所有的補給品。
你想去哪個城鎮？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐揚

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Let me give you
some supplies. Then
you will transported
to the chosen town.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
讓我給你一些補給品。
